hints.hub_body:
Every day, press **Start Today's Workout** and follow the pages — breathing first, then 3 short exercises. It takes about 15–30 minutes.

Tap **Got it** to hide this tip. You can always reopen **How to use** below.
hints.breathing_title: First time here? Follow the circle
hints.breathing_body: Press **▶ Start the breathing circle** and breathe with it — it grows as you breathe in and shrinks as you breathe out, and stops by itself when the practice is done. Tap 🔊 play to hear the instructions read aloud.
hints.training_body: Read each card, look at the picture, and follow the steps. Tap 🔊 play to hear the instructions. After each exercise, choose how it felt — then press **Submit Workout** at the bottom of the page.
hints.summary_title: Well done — that's today's session complete!
hints.summary_body: Press **Return to Daily Hub** and come back tomorrow for your next session.
hints.rest_body: Today is lighter — no exercises. A few short questions about your week help the program adjust your exercises. Press **Start Weekly Review** when you're ready.
hints.help_body:
• Press **Start Today's Workout** each day and follow the pages.
• Each session: breathing practice, then 3 exercises (~15–30 min).
• After each exercise, say how it felt, then submit.
• One day a week is a rest and review day.
• Use 🔊 play to hear the instructions read aloud.
• Bookmark this page to stay logged in.
